title: Overtrading nudges (playground)
description: Journey-aware P&L limit and TP/SL prompts: silent help on the order pad, and one nudge sheet when the revenge flag and the journey engine agree.

screens.name: Order pad · silent help
screens.note: The default — no interruption. The F&O commodity order pad (fno-25) as it is, plus silent help: “Set TPSL” becomes a TP/SL row, pre-filled and on (Target +20% · Stop-loss −10%); “Set a loss limit for today” is the first line of the dock. Buy fires the nudge picked in the settings (Case, Data state), once: the shared cap is 1 per session.

screens.name: Nudge · from settings
screens.note: The one nudge sheet, filled by the case and data state picked in the settings. Try all 17 cases × A / B / C and the draft’s two guardrail buttons.

screens.name: Nudge · generic
screens.note: Fires on Positions with the revenge flag when no single behaviour stands out, or the trader is too new to compare (state D). No bars; the group line. Dismiss says just “Not now” (no order in hand).

screens.name: Nudge · size-up · A (own loss)
screens.note: Bars: this order vs the trade he lost (2X). Enough history and his last size-up lost: the line is his own loss, on a red strip.

screens.name: Nudge · orders today · B
screens.note: Bars: his usual day vs today (3X). Last time didn’t lose: the line is the group (7 in 10 lost more).

screens.name: Nudge · orders today · C (thin history)
screens.note: Too few past sessions for “your usual”: the headline becomes today’s raw fact (“14 orders today”), no bars.

screens.name: Nudge · averaging down (TP/SL first)
screens.note: A case whose main button is TP/SL and whose fact isn’t a multiple: no bars: headline + the group line.

screens.name: Set today’s loss limit
screens.note: From the nudge’s “Set a loss limit for today” or the order pad dock. Pre-filled ₹25,000, quick amounts as pill tabs. Set limit → back to the pad with the limit shown.

screens.name: TP/SL for this order
screens.note: From the nudge’s “Add TP/SL to this order” or the TP/SL row. Target and stop-loss in %, the exit price under each.

screens.name: Order pad · limit set
screens.note: Silent help once a limit exists: “₹25,000 left of today’s loss limit” with a bar in the dock (tap to change it).

screens.name: Order pad · close to the limit
screens.note: ₹21,000 of ₹25,000 used: the bar and the line turn warning. Still no interruption.
